profile_text.body:
Tata Consultancy Services (TCS) is an Indian information technology services and consulting company headquartered in Mumbai, part of the Tata Group, operating in 150 locations across 46 countries. As of 2024 Tata Sons owned 71.74 percent of it, and TCS supplied close to 80 percent of Tata Sons' dividend income.

Source: Wikipedia, Tata Consultancy Services, retrieved 22 September 2026.
